title: 第一卷 第13章 林伯，我来给您搓背吧！
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

屏风后水声淅沥。

林骁坐在桌边，一杯接一杯地喝，却压不住心头那点燥热。

水声停了。

过了片刻，屏风后传来上官飞燕试探的声音：“老头？你还在吗？”

林骁没应。

“老头？”声音高了些。

林骁依旧沉默。

屏风猛地被掀开一角，上官飞燕慌张探出身，下一秒，她僵住了。

林骁不知何时已站在屏风旁，两人四目相对。

空气凝固。

林骁的目光不由自主下移，水珠顺着她脖颈滑落，没入胸前那抹惊心动魄的白皙。

他呼吸一顿，没想到这位郡主的身材这么好。

“啊——！”上官飞燕尖叫转身，“老登徒子！你、你干嘛？！”

“不是你喊我么？”林骁咳嗽一声，移开视线。

“我喊那么多声，你应一声就好！谁让你过来了！”

“老头子耳背。”林骁转身走回床边，和衣躺下，“别气，你继续洗，我不看。”

上官飞燕匆匆擦干身子，套上衣服，回头一看，林骁竟已打起鼾。

她更气了，跺脚低骂：“本郡主国色天香，在你身边沐浴，你居然睡着？死老头！”

她冲过去，在他耳边大喊：“起床——！”

林骁打个哈欠，伸个懒腰：“这床真舒服……要不，你驾马车回去？我留宿一晚。”

“不行！”上官飞燕想都没想便拒绝了，“我自己回去，你在这儿风花雪月？苏姐姐和冷姐姐还在家等呢！”

“也罢。”林骁起身，目光却落在浴桶上，细细打量。

“死老头！”上官飞燕脸又红了，“别人的洗澡水你也要看？”

“思想龌龊。”林骁瞪她。

“我龌龊？”

“我是想带个浴桶回去，给馨月、清雪也好洗洗。”

上官飞燕眼睛一亮：“好啊好啊！”

下楼结账时，林骁对小二道：“再加个浴桶，四床棉被，要丝绸被面。”

小二愣住：“客官，酒楼的东西……不外卖。”

“我给钱。”林骁掏出银两。

“这不是钱的事，是规矩……”

就在这时，江如烟从楼梯缓步而下，紫裙摇曳。

“老先生想要，自然可以，不过，老先生这就要走？”江如烟声音妩媚动人。

“天色不早，该回了。”

“如烟还为老先生备了歌舞……”

“改日，改日我单独来。”林骁咧嘴笑。

江如烟也不强留，对小二道：“去备浴桶、棉被，挑好的。”

“是！”

东西很快搬来。

林骁问价，江如烟摆手：“免了，您是我的贵客。”

林骁正色道：“这可不行，老头子一把年纪，不占人便宜。”

上官飞燕在一旁暗自嘀咕：刚刚还占我便宜呢，哼。

江如烟再次推拒，林骁想了想：“这样，老头子喜好书法，给贵店题首诗，聊表心意。”

“那太好了，如烟最欣赏文人了。”

笔墨纸砚备好。

林骁提笔蘸墨，略一沉吟，落笔：

“对酒当歌，人生几何，譬如朝露，去日苦多，慨当以慷，忧思难忘，何以解忧，唯有杜康……”

一首《短歌行》写完，江如烟怔住了。

她拿起纸，反复看了两遍，抬头时眼中难掩惊艳：“老先生文采斐然……对酒当歌，人生几何，真是绝句。”

“酒后胡言，见笑了。”

江如烟当即让小二搬来两箱好酒：“先生务必收下，如烟愿与先生交个朋友。”

林骁不再推辞，拱手道谢。

马车驶离酒楼。

二楼窗前，江如烟静静看着车影没入夜色。

身后一名手下低声道：“如烟姐，要不要做掉他们？”

“不必。”江如烟指尖抚过诗稿墨迹，“这老头有意思，他会再来的。”

“可他赢了那么多银子……”

江如烟回眸一瞥，手下立刻低头。

“他步伐沉稳，气息浑厚，绝非普通老农，常年狩猎，身手定不凡，莫要冒险。”江如烟淡淡说道。

“是。”

手下退下，另一人凑近：“狗哥，干不干？”

被唤狗哥的汉子目露凶光：“老板太谨慎，一个老头子，能有多厉害？叫上弟兄，半道动手。”

The sound of water splashed behind the screen.

Lin Xiao sat at the table, drinking cup after cup, but couldn't suppress the heat in his heart.

The sound of water stopped.

After a while, Shangguan Feiyan's probing voice came from behind the screen: "Old man? Are you still there?"

Lin Xiao didn't respond.

"Old man?" The voice was louder.

Lin Xiao remained silent.

A corner of the screen was suddenly opened, and Shangguan Feiyan leaned out in panic. The next second, she froze.

Lin Xiao didn't know when he was standing next to the screen, and the two looked at each other.

The air freezes.

Lin Xiao's eyes moved downward involuntarily, and the water drops slid down her neck, sinking into the shocking whiteness on her chest.

He took a breath, but he didn't expect the princess to be in such good shape.

"Ah——!" Shangguan Feiyan screamed and turned around, "Old disciple! What, what are you doing?!"

"Didn't you call me?" Lin Xiao coughed and looked away.

"I shouted so many times, just answer! Who asked you to come here!"

"The old man is deaf." Lin Xiao turned around and walked back to the bed, lying down with his clothes on, "Don't be angry, you continue to wash, I won't watch."

Shangguan Feiyan hurriedly dried herself and put on clothes. When she looked back, she saw that Lin Xiao was already snoring.

She became even more angry, stamped her feet and cursed in a low voice: "My princess is beautiful and fragrant. I am bathing next to you, and you actually fall asleep? Damn old man!"

She rushed over and shouted in his ear: "Get up—!"

Lin Xiao yawned and stretched: "This bed is so comfortable... How about you drive back in a carriage? I'll stay overnight."

"No!" Shangguan Feiyan refused without even thinking, "I'll go back by myself, and you're having fun here? Sister Su and Sister Leng are still waiting at home!"

"That's alright." Lin Xiao stood up, but his eyes fell on the tub, looking at it carefully.

"Damn old man!" Shangguan Feiyan's face turned red again, "You also want to read other people's bath water?"

"Dirty thoughts." Lin Xiao glared at her.

"Am I dirty?"

"I want to bring a bathtub back so that Xinyue and Qingxue can wash themselves."

Shangguan Feiyan's eyes lit up: "Okay, okay!"

When he went downstairs to check out, Lin Xiao said to the waiter: "Another bathtub, four quilts, and silk quilts."

The waiter was stunned: "Sir, the restaurant's food... is not available for takeout."

"I'll give you the money." Lin Xiao took out the silver coins.

"This is not about money, it's about rules..."

At this moment, Jiang Ruyan slowly walked down the stairs, her purple skirt swaying.

"If the old gentleman wants it, of course he can, but the old gentleman is leaving now?" Jiang Ruyan's voice was charming.

"It's getting late, it's time to go back."

"Ruyan also prepared songs and dances for the old gentleman..."

"Another day, another day I will come alone." Lin Xiao grinned.

Jiang Ruyan didn't force him to stay, and said to the waiter: "Go prepare a bathtub and quilt, and pick them out."

"Yes!"

Things were moved quickly.

Lin Xiao asked about the price, Jiang Ruyan waved his hand: "No need, you are my distinguished guest."

Lin Xiao said sternly: "That's not okay. The old man won't take advantage of others despite his age."

Shangguan Feiyan muttered secretly on the side: You just took advantage of me, huh.

Jiang Ruyan refused again, and Lin Xiao thought for a moment: "In this case, the old man likes calligraphy and writes a poem for your store to express his feelings."

"That's great. Ruyan admires literati the most."

Pen, ink, paper and inkstone are ready.

Lin Xiao dipped his pen in the ink, pondered for a moment, and then wrote:

"Singing over wine, life is like dew in the morning, the past days are full of hardships, be generous with generosity, worry is unforgettable, how can you relieve worries, only Du Kang..."

After finishing writing a "Dan Ge Xing", Jiang Ruyan was stunned.

She picked up the paper and read it twice. When she raised her head, she couldn't hide her surprise: "The old gentleman has a great literary talent... He sings and drinks while drinking, and the geometry of life is really a quatrain."

"You talk nonsense after drinking, it's ridiculous."

Jiang Ruyan immediately asked the waiter to bring two boxes of good wine: "Sir, you must accept it. Ruyan would like to make friends with you."

Lin Xiao stopped refusing and held up his hands to express his thanks.

The carriage left the restaurant.

In front of the second floor window, Jiang Ruyan quietly watched the car shadow disappear into the night.

A subordinate behind him whispered: "Sister Ruyan, do you want to kill them?"

"No need." Jiang Ruyan's fingertips touched the ink on the poem, "This old man is interesting, he will come again."

"But he won so much money..."

Jiang Ruyan glanced back, and his men immediately lowered their heads.

"He has a steady pace and a strong aura. He is no ordinary farmer. He hunts all year round and has extraordinary skills. Don't take risks." Jiang Ruyan said lightly.

"Yes."

The man retreated and another man came closer: "Brother Dog, do you want to do it?"

The man who was called Brother Dog showed a fierce look in his eyes: "The boss is too cautious. How powerful can an old man be? Call the brothers and start halfway."
